delete.title: Delete category?
delete.question: Are you sure you want to delete {{ categoryName }}?
delete.leafMessage: This action cannot be undone. Deletion may be blocked while this category is used by an active workflow.
delete.blockedMessage: This category has subcategories. Delete or move those subcategories before trying again.
delete.candidateBlockedMessage: This category cannot be deleted because it is still needed by an active transaction workflow. Resolve that workflow first.
delete.failed: This category could not be deleted. Resolve the remaining references and try again.
